blocks: The council approved the budget in March, and the first phase of works began shortly afterwards on the eastern quay.
Engineers found that the sea wall was structurally sound but that the drainage channels needed urgent and costly attention before winter.
Full survey results are published on the project website and are updated every quarter.
Most of the funding comes from the regional growth fund, with the remainder raised through local bonds issued last year.
Important: residents should expect some disruption, particularly at weekends, while the new moorings are installed.
The second phase is planned for the autumn. It depends on the outcome of the tender. A further update will follow in June.
Questions about the programme can be sent to the harbour office at any time.
The contractor has now reorganised the delivery schedule to avoid the busiest ferry sailings.

Harbour Office
Quay Street
Open weekdays from nine until five
Contact the harbour office for berth allocations and visitor moorings.
Draft for consultation. Comments are welcome until the end of the month.
